parent_objective: run one 4096-step guarded PPO proposal from the M1045 public-gate base and gate it without promotion
blocked_by: M1047 passed 1024-step fresh-seed repeats but does not prove a longer PPO proposal remains proof-safe
invalidates: claiming short PPO escalation stability without a 4096-step gated proposal

public_gates: M1049 must run exactly one 4096-step guarded PPO proposal
M1049 must not use private holdout
M1049 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M1049 must gate the raw PPO checkpoint against exact M997/M297/M270 and combined active-set checks
M1049 must gate the raw PPO checkpoint against six public proof replay surfaces
M1049 must gate source-diverse diagnostics, fresh public seeds, moderate-OOD seed, and behavior ablations
M1049 must fail on M267/M264 row15 wrong-history success or M183/M170 row16 normal-history failure
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run medium or long PPO
do not skip exact or combined active-set checks
do not skip proof replay gates
do not accept aggregate eval if row15 or row16 proof washes out
do not change loss coefficients while testing the short escalation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the M1044/M1047 guarded PPO recipe remains exact/proof/generalization safe at four times the smoke PPO budget
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: single-seed short-escalation diagnostic only; no promotion, no private holdout, no repeatability claim
stop_condition: stop if PPO crashes or metrics are non-finite
stop if exact or combined active-set retention regresses
stop if any public proof replay surface fails
stop if row15 wrong-history failure or row16 normal-history success flips
fallback_plan: if all gates pass, route to short-escalation fresh-seed repeat
if exact or proof gates fail, route to localized short-escalation failure audit before recipe changes
if training is unstable, route to PPO recipe audit
if fresh/OOD/behavior regresses while proof holds, route to generalization or behavior regression audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1048 admits a bounded short PPO escalation after M1047 passes 2/2 smoke repeats

hypothesis: One 4096-step guarded PPO proposal from the M1045 public-gate base can complete with finite metrics and preserve exact, proof, source-diverse, fresh/OOD, and behavior gates without promotion.
success_criteria: exact and combined active-set gates pass
all six public replay surfaces pass
fresh public and moderate-OOD gates pass
row15 and row16 rollback checks pass
no promotion or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: PPO run crashes or checkpoint is missing
exact or combined active-set gate fails
decision_rule: M1049 ran one 4096-step PPO proposal and full public gates. It must not promote, use private holdout, or claim repeatability.
